output_contract.notes: All energy quantities are in kJ/mol. The six systems for interaction energies are PEF/COFs, OFL/COFs, NOR/COFs, PEF/CNTs@COFs, OFL/CNTs@COFs, NOR/CNTs@COFs. The metadynamics systems are only PEF/COFs and OFL/CNTs@COFs.
